facts.fact: INT decision 165/2013 orders the national operator to offer alternative operators regulated, cost-oriented access to international capacity (STM-1 to STM-64, priced) and co-location at its Bizerte landing station for Sea-Me-We 4 (Bizerte-Marseille).
The INT decision treats Sea-Me-We 4 (Bizerte-Marseille) as an operating cable whose international capacity is under-used.

systems.country_label: cable Kelibia-Mazara del Vallo, described as deployed by alternative operators; the decision does not say it was in service
